toegepas.voor: Hulle koop dit of hulle verbou dit self.
toegepas.na: Hulle koop dit, of hulle verbou dit self.
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: 'of' joins two sentences that each have their own subject and verb, so a comma goes before it.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma: 'Hulle koop dit' and 'hulle verbou dit self' each have their own subject and verb, joined by 'of'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 requires the comma here; no words added and the meaning is unchanged.

toegepas.voor: So begin baie van die kos wat ons koop by 'n boer.
toegepas.na: So begin baie van die kos wat ons koop, by 'n boer.
toegepas.rede_vinder: Without a comma after the relative clause the sentence reads as 'the food we buy from a farmer'; the comma closes the clause so 'by 'n boer' attaches to 'begin'.
toegepas.fout: Without a comma, 'die kos wat ons koop by 'n boer' reads first as 'the food we buy from a farmer', which contradicts the block's point that we buy from a shop.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma closes the relative clause so 'by 'n boer' attaches to 'begin'; it removes a real stumble without adding words.

toegepas.rede_vinder: 'daarby' and 'ook' both mean 'in addition', so one is redundant and the sentence reads more smoothly with only 'ook'.
toegepas.fout: 'daarby ook' says 'in addition' twice, which reads slightly wooden.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'ook' alone carries the same meaning, the sentence gets one word shorter, and nothing protected is touched.

toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS 2017: the part after 'maar' has no subject of its own (it shares 'n Kosversamelaar), so no comma goes before 'maar'.
toegepas.fout: Comma before 'maar' where the second part has no subject of its own (it shares 'n Kosversamelaar).
toegepas.rede_keurder: AWS 2017 puts no comma between parts of one sentence; the protected words 'Kosversamelaar' and 'plant' stay intact.

toegepas.voor: Dit beteken hulle kan mense of diere siek maak of skade doen as dit in die liggaam kom, soos wanneer dit geëet word.
toegepas.na: Dit beteken dat hulle mense of diere siek kan maak of skade kan doen as hulle in die liggaam kom, soos wanneer hulle geëet word.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The sentence refers to the same plants, berries and mushrooms first as 'hulle' and then as 'dit'; one pronoun throughout, with 'dat' and the verbs at the end, makes it correct and clear.
toegepas.fout: The pronoun switches from 'hulle' to 'dit' for the same plants, berries and mushrooms inside one sentence, so a reader can stumble over what 'dit' refers to.
toegepas.rede_keurder: One pronoun throughout fixes a real reference fault; 'giftig' and the meaning stay the same, so the two extra words are justified.

toegepas.voor: Daarom moet iemand wat kos versamel die plante baie goed ken.
toegepas.na: Daarom moet iemand wat kos versamel, die plante baie goed ken.
toegepas.rede_vinder: A comma after the embedded relative clause stops 'versamel die plante' from being read together as verb and object.
toegepas.fout: Without a comma after the embedded clause, 'versamel die plante' reads first as verb plus object.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The comma after the embedded relative clause removes a real misreading; no words are added and 'versamel' stays.
